observations.title: Uptrend mostly intact (6/7 trend-template checks)
observations.detail: Missing: price above the 50-day. Leaders in a Stage 2 uptrend typically meet all seven; stocks failing several are rarely where the strongest moves start.

observations.title: Trading below the 50-day average
observations.detail: Leaders usually hold the 50-day. A close below it, especially on heavy volume, is a common warning sign.

observations.title: 23% below the 52-week high
observations.detail: A long way from the highs: overhead supply from holders who bought higher can cap rallies.

observations.title: 8 distribution days in the last 25 sessions
observations.detail: Down days on higher volume than the day before: a cluster of them shows persistent selling.

observations.title: High volatility: ATR is 6.4% of price
observations.detail: Daily swings are wide, so a normal stop distance risks more per share; smaller position sizes are common practice.

observations.title: Gap down of 4.1% on 2026-11-10
observations.detail: Watch whether the gap holds: gaps that fill within days often signal a failed move.

levels.label: 52-week high
levels.note: A close above it on volume above 4.5M shares (1.4x the 50-day average) is the classic breakout confirmation.

levels.label: 20-day high
levels.note: Short-term resistance from the recent swing high.

levels.label: 50-day average (resistance)
levels.note: Price is below it: the average now acts as resistance until reclaimed.

levels.label: 21-day average (resistance)
levels.note: Price is below it: the average now acts as resistance until reclaimed.

levels.label: 7-8% below today's close
levels.note: O'Neil's rule of thumb is to cut losses 7-8% below the purchase price. Shown from today's close (65.58 to 66.29) for scale only.

levels.label: 2 x ATR below today's close
levels.note: ATR(14) is 4.58; two ATRs is a common volatility-based distance for judging noise vs a real move.
